subject: 400 Mystic Avenue Herb Chambers Redevelopment
overview: The board approved a special permit and site plan for the redevelopment of a car dealership, incorporating several pedestrian and traffic safety revisions. Staff also provided informal progress updates on several major commercial projects throughout the city.

items.title: 400 Mystic Ave Special Permit and Site Plan Review
items.summary: Approved a special permit and site plan for 400 Mystic LLC to construct a new three-story structure and renovate an existing five-story building for the Herb Chambers Toyota dealership. The approval included conditions requiring an updated utility plan and traffic management contingencies should MassDOT require a 'right-in, right-out' access configuration.

items.title: Project Updates and Board Recognition
items.summary: The board recognized member Pam Marianski for her service and received staff updates on the construction status of Raising Cane's, the Great American Beer Hall, and the H-Mart project. Staff noted that demolition permits have been filed for the Wackling Fort project and that EV charging stations were approved for the local Stop & Shop.
